summary: This directory manages tracking and versioning of file states through snapshotting mechanisms. It enables the system to detect changes in source files by comparing current states against stored hashes, allowing for selective re-analysis and efficient processing of modified content.
responsibilities: Maintain cached hash entries for file state verification
relationships: File change types define the nature of modifications applied to file paths.
File hash entries are compared against existing snapshots to identify if a file requires re-analysis.
designDecisions: Explicit categorization of file modification states
Caching strategy for tracking source file changes
